provenance: Runtime-independent acceptance cases grounded in current PeopleOfTheIliacBay.Core event, appointment producer, inbox, and appraisal request/response contracts. Synthetic identifiers/observations only. These cases define invariants, not calibrated relationship deltas or model text.

currentContractReferences.transaction: Do not assume a transaction member name. The parent-owned atomic consumer must be located and verified before wiring these cases.

reviewRules: Distinguish construction/request validity from semantic suitability and from atomic state acceptance.
Keep native causal facts separate from observer knowledge and attributed speech.
Use exact receipt/observer/speaker/episode/time binding for observed utterances.
Do not hard-code a target mood/affinity/trust/fear delta or exact sentence.
A rejected, replayed, stale, or wrong-branch proposal leaves all relevant state unchanged.

cases.currentContractSupport: request-and-parser-supported; appraisal is not an effect or an automatic trust grant

invariants: Gift may inform mood and gradual affinity when giver is known and the relationship target is bound.
MoneyReceived never supports positive trust in the current parser.
No friendship or trust effect is implied as a fixed outcome.
Do not attribute gratitude or resentment to the player.
Current request cannot target a relationship because giver attribution is unknown.
Mood appraisal may be considered; directed relationship changes require a known target.

atomicAcceptance.acceptOnlyWith: response bound to current branch, evidence key and captured revisions
atomicAcceptance.replay: one canonical outcome can be consumed once per observer; repeated appraisal yields no second state change

cases.currentContractSupport: native CombatHelp outcome and attributed speech are distinct origins; speech claim cannot establish outcome

invariants: A real confirmed CombatHelp outcome may support a trust proposal when relationship evidence is bound.
The proposal remains distinct from a completed relationship update until atomic acceptance.

npcKnowledge.help: player said they rescued the NPC; no confirming outcome receipt

invariants: Keep the statement attributed to the speaker; do not convert it into a native rescue fact.
Current response parser rejects any trust change on attributed-speech events.
No rescue, gratitude, or reward is confirmed by the claim alone.

atomicAcceptance.replay: same receipt and canonical outcome must not increase trust twice
atomicAcceptance.claimIsolation: speech and outcome evidence remain separate records

cases.currentContractSupport: NpcAppointmentExperience.TryCreate supports confirmed attended/player-absent receipts; interrupted and npc-absent do not create blame evidence

invariants: Request creation requires actual native observed-wait evidence.
Consume the canonical appointment event once.
Do not apply the existing no-show penalty a second time during appraisal.
No AppointmentNoShow event or blame for the player is created by interruption.
Current producer rejects this status as no-show evidence.
Do not infer who caused an interruption without separate observer-known evidence.
NPC absence is not player absence.
No player no-show event is created.

atomicAcceptance.onceOnly: The existing appointment outcome and penalty are authoritative; any subsequent relationship proposal consumes the receipt once without duplicating the established penalty.

cases.currentContractSupport: NpcObservedConversationTurn and speech-act response vocabulary exist; current event factory requires a claimed NpcExperienceEventKind even for speech-only threat, which is not a truthful fit
cases.contractGap: Do not label a pure threat as Injury, StatusOnset, or another world-event claim merely to satisfy the current factory. A speech-only receipt/event representation is needed before this contrast can be fully executed through current CreateRequest.

directArm.speaker: player
directArm.frame: speaker directly threatens the family member

quotedArm.speaker: player
quotedArm.frame: speaker quotes another person's line from a play; prior observer-known turn attributes the source

invariants: Only receipt-bound observed text and same-episode context may classify the speech act.
Direct and quoted/reported threat remain distinct; quoted speech is not a direct threat.
Threatened future harm is not a verified injury, crime, culprit, or committed action.
Only the direct, observer-known self/family target may use the current severe negative bounds; the bounds remain provisional and do not prescribe an exact effect.

atomicAcceptance.dedupe: Canonical utterance ID plus observer and episode prevents replay as another threat.
atomicAcceptance.adapter: Future speech-only event contract must bind receipt, speaker, observer, episode, utterance and observed game time.

cases.currentContractSupport: TryParseResponse uses supplied PositiveAffinityCredit as positive ceiling and separate provisional negative bound for a receipt-bound direct threat to observer/known family

evidence.canonicalUtterance: receipt-bound direct threat to known family member

invariants: Positive affinity must not exceed PositiveAffinityCredit.
Negative direct-threat appraisal is checked against its separate provisional severe-loss bound, not the positive-growth ceiling.
No numeric target delta is prescribed; boundary checks may read current Core constants.
Any eventual commit must match current branch, observer, speaker target, and affinity/relationship revisions.
cases.currentLimit: Speech-only event-construction gap described in appraisal.direct-vs-quoted-threat applies here too.

cases.currentContractSupport: event canonical dedupe is enforced at inbox enqueue; response parser echoes save branch, canonical evidence and expected revisions; atomic appraisal consumer is an integration seam unless parent transaction adds it

attempts.capturedRevisions: match saved mood, affinity, and directed-relationship state
attempts.expected: eligible for one atomic acceptance if the whole proposal validates
reject as duplicate; no second mood or relationship write
reject; do not silently import appraisal across branches

attempts.expected: reject with all target ledgers unchanged

invariants: Native event identity, branch and all affected revisions are checked before any write.
Mood, affinity and directed relationship changes plus inbox consumption are one atomic outcome: all accepted together or none changed.
Chat sequence or replayed appraisal is not a new event.
If transaction support has not landed, report this scenario as a missing integration seam instead of passing it against a fake method.
